steps.name: the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-01 Verify Activities link is present in navigation

steps.name: the Activities link should be visible in the navigation bar
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-02 Verify clicking Activities navigates to Activities page

steps.name: the user clicks the Activities link
the browser URL should contain "/activities/"
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-03 Verify Activities page displays activity cards

steps.name: the user navigates to the Activities page
at least one activity card should be visible on the page
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-04 Verify This Weekend filter button is present on Activities page

steps.name: the user navigates to the Activities page
the "This Weekend" filter button should be visible on the page
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-05 Verify clicking This Weekend filter refreshes the list

steps.name: the user is on the Activities page
the user clicks the "This Weekend" filter button
the activity list should refresh and show results
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-06 Verify activities list is not empty after This Weekend filter

steps.name: the user is on the Activities page
the user clicks the "This Weekend" filter button
at least one activity card should be displayed after filtering
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-07 Verify This Weekend filter shows weekend dates on cards

steps.name: the user is on the Activities page
the user clicks the "This Weekend" filter button
the activity cards should be visible on the page
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-08 Verify Filters button opens sort panel

steps.name: the user has applied the This Weekend filter on Activities page
the user clicks the Filters button on Activities page
the filter panel should open showing sort options
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-09 Verify Price Low to High sort option is selectable

steps.name: the user has opened the Filters panel on Activities page
the user selects "Price : Low to High" sort option
the "Price : Low to High" sort option should be selected
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-10 Verify activities are reordered after applying price sort

steps.name: the user has opened the Filters panel on Activities page
the user selects "Price : Low to High" sort option
the user clicks Apply Filters button
the Activities page should be displayed with sorted results
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-11 Verify filter panel closes after clicking Apply Filters

steps.name: the user has opened the Filters panel on Activities page
the user selects "Price : Low to High" sort option
the user clicks Apply Filters button
the filter panel should be closed
the user is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter and Price Low to High sort applied

elements.name: TC-12 Verify activity name is extracted from each card

steps.name: activity names should be extracted as non-empty strings
the user is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter and Price Low to High sort applied

elements.name: TC-13 Verify activity price is extracted from each card

steps.name: activity prices should be extracted in rupee format from each card
the user is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter and Price Low to High sort applied

elements.name: TC-14 Verify activity venue is extracted from each card

steps.name: activity venues should be extracted as non-empty strings
the user is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter and Price Low to High sort applied

elements.name: TC-15 Verify all extracted data is stored in a Java collection

steps.name: the extracted activity data should be stored in a collection
the collection size should match the number of visible activity cards
the user is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter and Price Low to High sort applied

elements.name: TC-16 Verify lowest price activity is the first item after sort

steps.name: the first activity in the list should have the lowest price
the user is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter and Price Low to High sort applied

elements.name: TC-17 Verify lowest price activity details are printed to console

steps.name: the lowest priced activity details should be printed to the console
the user is on the Activities page with This Weekend filter and Price Low to High sort applied

elements.name: TC-18 Verify printed activity price is a valid numeric value

steps.name: the lowest activity price should be a valid numeric value greater than zero

elements.name: TC-19 Verify Movies link is present in navigation

elements.name: TC-20 Verify clicking Movies navigates to Movies page

steps.name: the user clicks the Movies link
the browser URL should contain "/movies/"
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-21 Verify Movies page displays movie cards

steps.name: the user navigates to the Movies page
at least one movie card should be visible on the page
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-22 Verify Filters button opens filter panel on Movies page

steps.name: the user is on the Movies page
the user clicks the Filters button on Movies page
the filter panel should open showing Genre Language and Format sections
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-23 Verify Language section is present in Movies filter panel

steps.name: the user has opened the filter panel on Movies page
the Language section heading should be visible in the filter panel
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-24 Verify language options are extracted from the filter panel

steps.name: the user has opened the filter panel on Movies page
the user clicks the Language tab in the filter panel
a list of language options should be captured with at least 2 entries
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-25 Verify extracted language list is printed to console

steps.name: the user has opened the filter panel on Movies page
the user clicks the Language tab in the filter panel
all language options should be printed to the console with no empty entries
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-26 Verify User Avatar button is present in navigation

steps.name: the User Avatar button should be visible in the navigation bar
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-27 Verify clicking User Avatar opens login modal

steps.name: the user clicks the User Avatar button
the login modal should appear with a mobile number input field
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-28 Verify login modal contains required UI elements

steps.name: the user clicks the User Avatar button
the login modal should show the mobile number input field
the login modal should show the country code "+91"
the login modal should show the Continue button
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-29 Verify error is shown for empty mobile number

steps.name: the login modal is open
the user leaves the mobile number field empty and clicks Continue
an error message should be displayed in the login modal
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-30 Verify error is shown for short mobile number

steps.name: the login modal is open
the user enters "12345" in the mobile number field and clicks Continue
an error message should be displayed below the input field
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-31 Verify error message text is captured by automation

steps.name: the login modal is open
the user enters "12345" in the mobile number field and clicks Continue
the error message text should be captured as a non-empty string
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-32 Verify user stays on login modal after invalid submission

steps.name: the login modal is open
the user enters "999" in the mobile number field and clicks Continue
the mobile number input field should still be visible
the user should not be navigated away from the login modal
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-33 Verify screenshot is taken after error message appears

steps.name: the login modal shows an error after entering "12345"
the automation takes a screenshot
the screenshot file should be saved to the screenshots directory
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-34 Verify screenshot file is saved with a valid name

steps.name: the login modal shows an error after entering "12345"
the automation takes a screenshot
the screenshot file should exist at the saved path and not be empty
the user is on the District home page

elements.name: TC-35 Verify screenshot shows the login error message

steps.name: the login modal shows an error after entering "12345"
the automation takes a screenshot named "login_error_screenshot"
the screenshot should be saved successfully without errors
